newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs marginally firmer.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs marginally firmer.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts were slightly firmer on Friday in line with a strong local market which has rallied all this week.
But the movements in GDR prices remained small and volume was light.
The market's latest support follows the resignation of former premier P.V. Narasimha Rao as head of the Congress Party amid a flurry of corruption charges.
The Cazenove Indian GDR Index rose 1.58 points to 70.39 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index gained 52.62 points to 3,088.53.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 16.44 percent.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 1.91 points up at 64.61 points, with the premium over the local market at 20.47 percent.
Bajaj Auto, a recent focus of the market, barely moved, hovering at just over $32.
Hidalco was up 22 cents at $23.75 and the State Bank of India rose 25 cents at $17.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended 0.09 percent lower at 64.67 points, with the premium over the local market falling to 42.45 percent from Thursday's 46.58 percent.
Taiwanese GDRs recovered slightly, edging up 0.23 percent to 93.71 points. The foreign premium was 3.58 percent, down from 3.79 percent on Thursday.
